cues: Plants have evolved tricks to avoid selfing.
In dichogamy the two sexes ripen at different times.
In protandry, as in sunflower, the anthers shed their pollen first, and the stigma of the same flower opens only after they are done.
text: Plants have evolved tricks to avoid selfing. In dichogamy the two sexes ripen at different times. In protandry, as in sunflower, the anthers shed their pollen first, and the stigma of the same flower opens only after they are done. Protogyny is the reverse.
